purpose: Brighter open-channel textures, only color edited

prompts.artery: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the COLOR PALETTE of the attached open-top canal material. A fresh luminous coral-red and warm pink channel: floor #FA9D92, sidewall #E66565, outer rim #A74352, bright narrow lip #FFD6BE. Increase saturation and freshness clearly, avoid orange/brown/muddy beige. Keep the same straight horizontal open channel, same broad FLAT INTERIOR FLOOR, exactly the same two thin raised sidewalls, geometry, composition, transparency and geometric anime cel-shading. The result should be noticeably more colorful and brighter while remaining readable and comfortable. Darker wall edge separates the bright traversable floor from the sidewall. Preserve all sharp high-resolution facet edges. Never add gloss, neon, glow or light haze. Never turn it into a convex closed tube. No cells, objects, icons or text. Preserve true alpha transparency; nothing outside the existing strip. One edge-to-edge seamless horizontal strip, landscape 1536x1024.
